system.moveDescription: Once per mystery, you can change a physical object that is a Clue into a Void Clue by describing secret markings, un usual patterns, or otherwise strange, occult details that are on it. If you have unlocked Layer Three of the Dark Conspir acy, tell the Keeper that the thresholds for each remaining layer are reduced by one Void Clue. No two Mavens can have this move at the same time. This move and the Clarice Starling move cannot be in the same game.
